description: Create a new TaScan project (top-level container for events). number is optional (the next P-number is assigned when omitted; a number already used in the org is refused 409). external_refs links customer job numbers.

external_refs.description: Up to 10 external references, each { source (1-40 chars, e.g. "EEQ"), ref (1-80 chars, e.g. "P14-4680") }

number.description: Project number, 1-40 letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen, unique in the org (default: next P-00001 style number). P-<digits> numbers are assigned automatically and refused 400 here; use your own format (e.g. P14-4680)

name: tascan_create_project
